payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array, then exhaustive triple loop checking only min-max difference <= 2 to verify condition.
payload.rationale: Sorting allows the condition max difference <=2 to be checked via endpoints only, avoiding pairwise checks. Brute-force triple enumeration then finds any valid set efficiently for small n.
